caseNameFull: The Columbian Correspondence College v. George B. Cortelyou, Postmaster-General
attorneys: Mr. Arthur A. Birhey and Mr.' Charles A. Ray for appellant. The Attorney General and The Solicitor General for appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.

Per Curiam. Mr. Arthur A. Birhey and Mr.' Charles A. Ray for appellant. The Attorney General and The Solicitor General for appellees.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. South Carolina v. Seymour, 153 U. S. 353, 357; United States v. Lynch, 137 U. S. 280, 286; Code District of Columbia, § 233.
